trust_decision.summary: The admin-writable 'pypi_url' setting (or the PYPI_URL env fallback) is trusted as a plain index URL and interpolated into a shell command line run through backticks during plugin install; the fix validates it as an http(s) URL and switches to an argv call with no shell.

landing_point.why: The only backtick shell call that interpolates pypi_url. A grep for pypi_url leads directly to the string-built pip_args at plugin_model.rb:271-283.

An over-broad fix that rejects http, ports or non-pypi.org hosts, or drops --trusted-host, would break them.
